s: Dine modim ubo g' seipim: be"modim" shochin techilla vasop, kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"g. Umi sheeno shocheh be"modim" — shidrato naaseh nachash leachar z' shanim achar moto (veeno qam bitchiyyat hammetim). Veim nizdammen lo roq be"modim" — lo yishcheh ad sheyyetze haroq:
Haomer "modim modim" keomer "shema shema" umeshatteqin oto, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"a:

Yachid en lo lomar "birkat kohanim" shehu "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'", ki betzibbur nitqena keneged nesiut kappayim sheenah ella baasara. Ulepikak ap hashsheliach tzibbur en omer bemincha ella betaanit tzibbur, mippene sheen nesiat kappayim bemincha ella betaanit tzibbur mishshum chashash shikrut, veereb rosh hashshana eno niqra taanit tzibbur. Veim nahagu sheap hayyachid omerah bazzeman harauy linsiut kappayim — en limchot:
